failedDevelopmentRuns: First alpha27 Android run stopped when the driver queried area fields before the dialog settled. Saved screenshot/node evidence showed the expected controls and no Construct crash. A bounded stable-field wait fixed the driver; APK and module bytes were unchanged for the completed rerun.

The initial synthetic consent fixture used inline CSS rejected by the existing module CSP. It failed before any consent assertion. New immutable 1.x fixture versions move styling into a packaged stylesheet; no host or production module change was made.

The first corrected-fixture consent run completed four old/new HTTP assertions, then hit the inherited 900-second child limit. It remained incomplete and was archived. The standalone consent matrix now has a bounded 3600-second budget; unrelated scopes retain their existing limits.

The longer combined consent run completed eight assertions before the emulator service was OOM-killed at its 4.5 GiB limit. That parent remains incomplete. HTTP and location were split into independently completed clean-snapshot scopes with a 1800-second cap each, without raising emulator memory limits.

The first isolated location scope completed the three consent assertions, then attempted a new sample installation while the previous version was still a trial. Native trial protection blocked the runner. The coarse sample now runs first on the clean candidate, before the old-state transitions.
